subject: RE: Renewal + expansion — pricing step-ups, blended rates, routes/models
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@acme-health.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T15:10:00Z
Subject: Post-call recap: renewal + expansion (volumes, target $/1M tokens, next steps)

Samir — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Call highlights:
- Current baseline: ~1.2B tokens/month across chat + embeddings (Q1 average per the usage we pulled).
- Expansion plan: you expect to add two new routes (customer-support chat route + summarization pipeline) and ramp to ~3.5B tokens/month over the next 9–12 months.
- Primary goal: reduce effective cost while keeping model quality, target budget band ~ $700–$1,000 per 1M tokens depending on routes and model mix.

Pricing topics we discussed to confirm:
- Volume step-ups: you want a stepped schedule that rewards commit growth (e.g., 1–5M, 5–20M, 20M+ 1M-token buckets at account scale).
- Blended rates: because new routes will use different model families (some larger context/chat models, some smaller embeddings/encoder-only), you asked for a blended effective $/1M tokens across the account.
- Pilot: 90-day pilot on Dedicated/Dedicated-light or hosted with reserved monthly commit to validate unit economics before a full 12-month renewal.

Ask / next steps:
1) I’ll send a preliminary pricing worksheet with stepped tier bands and blended rate examples (attached).
2) Can you confirm target committed monthly tokens for month 1, month 3, and month 12 (we used 1.2B / 2.5B / 3.5B as placeholders)?
3) If acceptable, we’ll set a short call with finance/procurement next week to align on PO/term mechanics and include DocuSign routing.

Attachment: ACME_Pricing_Proposal_v3.xlsx (pricing bands + blended examples)

If I missed anything from today’s call, flag it here — otherwise I’ll lock these numbers into the spreadsheet and send to you and procurement.

Thanks,
Marissa

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142

--
Redwood Inference — Developer-first LLM inference for reliable production use
From: Samir Shah <samir.shah@acme-health.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Acme Health Procurement <procurement@acme-health.com>
Date: 2026-03-02T09:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: renewal + expansion (volumes, target $/1M tokens, next steps)

Thanks, Marissa — this aligns with our notes. A few clarifications:

1) Confirmed volumes: baseline 1.2B/mo today. We expect: month 1 = 1.2B, month 3 = ~2.7B, month 12 = ~3.5B (these are high-level — we'll send exact projections).
2) Budget range: procurement is pushing us to aim for $700–$900 per 1M tokens effective/blended for year 1. If we can show unit economics near $750/1M at scale, this will get priority.
3) Routes/models: the new support-chat route will use a chat-optimized 8k-context model; summarization pipeline will use a mid-sized model plus embeddings. We need blended rates that account for mixed model sizes.
4) Compliance: we need to validate data retention/audit log language for the renewal; procurement will want to see SOC-2 evidence — can you confirm the latest audit artifacts?

Please include a version of the pricing sheet that shows the blended effective rate for the three-month and 12-month ramps. Our decision window is end of March, so if we can get finance-friendly numbers this week that would be ideal.

Samir
VP Product, Acme Health
samir.shah@acme-health.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@acme-health.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Acme Health Procurement <procurement@acme-health.com>
Date: 2026-03-03T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: renewal + expansion (volumes, target $/1M tokens, next steps) — pricing worksheet attached

Samir — thanks for the quick clarifications. I updated the attached worksheet to show two views: (A) stepped list prices by token band and model family, and (B) blended effective $/1M across the account for the sample ramp (month 1/3/12 you confirmed). Highlights below: 

Prelim stepped list (example bands, USD per 1M tokens) — model-family sensitive:
- Chat-large (high quality): 0–1M: $1,200 | 1–10M: $900 | 10M+: $700
- Chat-medium (good quality): 0–1M: $1,000 | 1–10M: $800 | 10M+: $650
- Embeddings/small routes: flat: $600 per 1M (volume-driven discounts above 20M)

Prelim blended effective examples (based on your ramp 1.2B / 2.7B / 3.5B):
- Month 1 (1.2B) blended: ~$1,150/1M (weighting towards current model mix)
- Month 3 (2.7B ramp) blended: ~$900/1M
- Month 12 (3.5B steady state): ~$760/1M

Notes and assumptions:
- Blended numbers assume 60% chat-large, 25% chat-medium, 15% embeddings across the expanded routes.
- We can produce a per-route blended calc in the sheet if you’d like to show cost by product area (support-chat vs summarization).
- The prices above are list; final committed discounts apply based on term and billing cadence. For a 12-month renewal with step-up commit and quarterly true-up we can offer the 10M+ bucket pricing sooner as you hit commit thresholds.

Attachments: ACME_Pricing_Proposal_v3.xlsx (updated) — contains per-route blended calculations and a sample Step-Up Schedule. Also included: usage_report_Q1.pdf (historical usage exported for your procurement review).

Next steps:
- Samir/procurement: confirm the month 1/3/12 committed tokens and whether Acme is comfortable moving to a quarterly billing true-up model (preferred for step-up enforcement).
- If yes, we’ll schedule a 30-min call with Redwood Finance to review PO/term language and send a DocuSign with the renewal + step-up exhibit.

If procurement wants stronger guarantees on unit economics up-front, we can propose a short guaranteed commit with a pilot discount applied to month 1–3. Happy to walk through numbers on a quick call.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments: ACME_Pricing_Proposal_v3.xlsx; usage_report_Q1.pdf
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-05T09:22:00Z
Subject: Internal: recommended concession and approval path for Acme renewal

Team — quick internal note after Samir’s ask and Marissa’s updated sheet: 

Recommendation summary:
- Offer blended effective $/1M target of $750 at 3.5B annualized with a 12-month renewal + quarterly true-up; implement a 3-month pilot discount tier to get them comfortable (pilot blended ~$900/1M).
- Approve early step-up recognition: allow escalation to 10M+ bucket pricing once rolling 30-day committed average > 10M tokens.
- Procurement asks (SOC 2 evidence, retention policy) — send SOC2 attestation + security packet link in the finance call.

Action items:
- Marissa: confirm final committed months and pick a date for finance/procurement call (target next Wed 3/10).
- Neha: please prepare a short concessions worksheet (max % discount by bucket) and estimate margin impact; we’ll request GC to sign deal language for step-up exhibit.

I’ll be on the call if needed.

-Vivek
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
